subject: Kickoff: SQIF factoring evaluation (Q2)
body:
Team — kicking off the SQIF factoring assessment.

Context: our open-source release implements the Schnorr-plus-quantum-optimization factoring approach, with a QAOA method and a classical bruteforce method for finding low-energy states of the hamiltonian. Leadership wants a sober internal read on how far this actually scales before anyone quotes it externally.

Deliverables inside the window: reproducible conda environment and CLI harness by Mar 16; bruteforce baselines across bitsizes through April; qaoa_depth and lattice-parameter sweeps in June; a written evaluation with Launch Review Board sign-off by Jun 29.

Ownership: Rosa the harness, Farah the baselines, Giannis sweep automation, Halima the analysis. Bruno follows up on staffing and compute.

Lucia
